argv: echo "commits touching tools/mutate-and-run.sh:"; for c in $(git log --all --format=%H -- tools/mutate-and-run.sh); do n=$(git show $c:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | wc -l); pl=$(git show $c:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | grep -n "^PIN_JS=" | cut -d: -f1); printf "%s lines=%s PIN_JS_at=%s\n" "${c:0:8}" "$n" "${pl:-none}"; done; echo "cf41efaa blob reachable: $(git rev-list --all --objects | grep -c "^cf41efaa")"; echo "tool blob at eb7838b: $(git rev-parse eb7838b:tools/mutate-and-run.sh)"
